method.classification: Classified with full precision, displayed to two decimals. AAA >=7, AA >=4.5, large/UI >=3, fail <3. Large text >=24 CSS px regular or >=18.67 CSS px bold. UI threshold applies to identifying information, not every decorative divider.
method.limitation: Numbers apply to solid supplied HEX values, not screenshot pixels with lighting/gradient overlays.
